entities.summary: Lu Haojie is a Chinese weightlifter. He competed for China at the 2012 Summer Olympics, winning the silver medal. At the 2012 Chinese National Games, Lu Haojie posted 175 kg in the snatch, and went on to win the National Games, placing ahead of Lu Xiaojun.
